story: You are a researcher at the University of Health Sciences, conducting a longitudinal study called 'HealthyLives.' You are collecting data on user behavior across various applications to understand how different factors influence user engagement and satisfaction. The dataset includes information on login frequency, device type, session duration, feature usage, and more, aiming to identify patterns that can improve user experience and retention.
